question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Hit the sack

options.text: To go to bed in order to read
To go to bed in order to write
To go to bed in order to sleep
Go to bed in order to sit

solution:
The correct answer is "**To go to bed in order to sleep"**.
